data.title: R&D Director
data.summary: The role leads hardware engineering and product execution from concept and prototyping to mass production. It also manages engineering teams, technical decisions, resources, and cross-functional collaboration.

requirements.question: What does 'driven and fast-thinking' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The role description uses these broad traits without explaining how they apply to the work.

requirements.text: Builder mindset in an evolving company environment
requirements.question: What does 'a builder mindset' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for a builder mindset without describing the behaviours expected in the role.

requirements.text: Growth attitude and openness to challenges and development
requirements.question: What does 'a growth attitude' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests a growth attitude but does not define how it is demonstrated in this position.

requirements.text: Hands-on approach and willingness to carry responsibility
requirements.question: What does 'hands-on approach' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting expects a hands-on approach without specifying the practical involvement required.

requirements.text: Initiative, independent responsibility, and delivery of results
requirements.question: What does 'independent responsibility' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting seeks independent responsibility and results without giving a concrete example of either.

requirements.text: Broad technical understanding of mechanics and electronics
Experience leading technical teams and owning outcomes under pressure
Practical ability to use modern AI tools in R&D workflows
Extensive engineering and hardware product development experience
requirements.question: Would someone who has done engineering and hardware product development, with fewer than 15 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting sets a long experience threshold for engineering and hardware product development.

requirements.question: Is English needed from day one, or could someone start in Finnish and build up English on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires professional English fluency while explicitly stating that fluent Finnish is not required.
